prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for choose_path copy, finish copy, and home wait_info changes, as each has only one test so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- choose_path, copy: +2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, copy: -3.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Carousel Redesign: Redesign the initial story screen layout into an interactive carousel with playful mascot illustrations to make path selection engaging. (why: The choose_path step has a long mean duration of 514s; presenting a visual carousel engages users early and reduces hesitation.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Pet Shortcut Card: Add a new screen right before completing onboarding displaying desktop interaction shortcuts and control guides. (why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets, and finish step conversion is 64.8%.)
2: [home, new_flow] Interactive Waiting Room Companion Game: Introduce a interactive tip carousel flow while waiting for desktop pet generation to keep users entertained during loading. (why: The home waiting step has a long median wait of 201s and high mean duration of 2336s.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Value Copy: Update headline and body on the choose_path screen to highlight instant desktop companionship benefits. (why: Evidence for choose_path copy changes is still thin with only one test conducted so far.)
4: [home, wait_info] Estimated Waiting Time Indicator: Display explicit progress bar and estimated generation time indicators on the waiting screen. (why: Evidence is thin for home wait_info changes, and mean wait time is high at 2336 seconds.)
5: [finish, notification] Desktop Launch Ready Notification Prompt: Add a desktop readiness notification setting on the home_intro screen to alert users when their pet lands on screen. (why: 3 support tickets noted pets not appearing on desktop, and completing onboarding overall sits at 17.8%.)
6: [finish, copy] Onboarding Finish Reassurance Copy: Update home_intro headline and button text to emphasize immediate desktop launch. (why: Evidence for finish copy changes is thin with only one test completed, while total onboarding completion is 17.8%.)
